02 — A LITTLE ABOUT ME

Your detail-oriented bookkeeping partner.

I'm Rogincel Demata, a Bookkeeping Virtual Assistant with QuickBooks Online certifications and a commitment to reliable financial recordkeeping. I'm also the founder of ZOEY Bookkeeping Services, a bookkeeping brand focused on U.S. entrepreneurs and small businesses.

My goal is simple: to support small business owners with accurate, organized, and timely bookkeeping. I bring attention to detail, integrity, confidentiality, and a willingness to keep learning to every task.
